name: How long does a typical bathroom tile installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom tile installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom tile installation varies depending on the size of the bathroom, the complexity of the tile pattern, and the type of tile. A small bathroom floor might take 1-2 days, while a full bathroom (floor and shower walls) can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days, including preparation, tile setting, grouting, and drying times. This estimate does not include demolition or custom work.
acceptedAnswer.description: A small bathroom floor may take 1-2 days, while a full bathroom with shower walls can take 3-7 days, depending on size and complexity.
